question: Should OpenClaw accept this experimental core `claws update` apply surface with its current `update_partial` recovery model once real external package and Gateway recovery proof is supplied?
rationale: Tests can validate local control flow, but only maintainers can accept the product and operator-recovery contract for cross-owner mutations that cannot share a transaction.

options.title: Require live proof, then reassess
options.body: Keep the experimental design paused until the contributor posts redacted exact-tree package replacement, Gateway retry/convergence, and retained-artifact recovery evidence.

options.title: Narrow the first apply surface
options.body: Land only a smaller owner set whose mutation and recovery behavior can be fully demonstrated, deferring package or Gateway application.

options.title: Accept the documented partial contract
options.body: Approve the fail-closed `update_partial` model as sufficient for the experimental gate despite the remaining external-boundary proof gap.

recommendation.title: Require live proof, then reassess
recommendation.body: Keep the experimental design paused until the contributor posts redacted exact-tree package replacement, Gateway retry/convergence, and retained-artifact recovery evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment directly frames the outstanding recovery and aggregate-consent decision.
